description: [Launch directories] Use this when working through launch directories with a required Submit Kit key. Returns exactly one next directory when available; submit there, then call report_result. May return report_first or done instead. At most 3 unreported sites, up to 50 per key; product_type is bound on first issuance. For a free overview list, use recommend_directories.

product_type.description: Needed on the first call only
